subject: Audit every graded lab for finishStage double-completion
description: ModuleProgress.complete() is not idempotent: it increments the lifetime modules-completed counter, calls updateStreak(), queues an activity event and shows the overlay. Labs whose task ticks are deliberately revocable (recomputed by evaluate) can re-enable their finish button after credit was already awarded, so pressing Finish again double-awards. Found by Nancy 2026-08-07 on ch25 forge-virtualization.lab.html, fixed there with a sticky LAB.completed flag persisted as completedOnce. Any lab sharing the evaluate/finishStage shape likely has the same gap; ch25 was simply the one where a rename feature made it easy to reach. Sweep the other .lab.html files that call ModuleProgress.complete from a re-evaluable button.
